name: ProbabilityTheory.posterior_eq_withDensity
type: {Ω : Type u} → {𝓧 : Type v} → {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} → {m𝓧 : MeasurableSpace 𝓧} → {κ : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel Ω 𝓧} → {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} → [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] → [ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel κ] → [StandardBorelSpace Ω] → [Nonempty Ω] → [MeasurableSpace.CountableOrCountablyGenerated Ω 𝓧] → (∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, κ ω ≪ κ ∘ₘ μ) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(κ ∘ₘ μ), (ProbabilityTheory.posterior κ μ) x = μ.withDensity (fun ω ↦ κ.rnDeriv (ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.const Ω (κ ∘ₘ μ)) ω x)
provides: Almost-everywhere Bayes formula: posterior is the prior weighted by the sampling kernel’s density relative to the prior predictive law, under the stated absolute-continuity and measurable-space assumptions.
